info.name: Render via a signed render link

params.name: token
params.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex signature of the URL-encoded options query string, signed with the project secret. Use 'true' for unsigned links if the project allows them.

params.name: url
params.description: The website URL to render (required unless html is supplied).

params.name: html
params.description: Raw HTML to render (required unless url is supplied).

items.docs: Returns a render directly from a stateless, cacheable URL. The token is an HMAC-SHA256 signature of the URL-encoded options query string, generated server-side with the project secret. Render options are passed as query-string parameters (url or html is required).
